articles.summary: MIAMI, FL — HEICO CORPORATION (NYSE: HEI.A) (NYSE: HEI) today announced that its Electronic Technologies Group acquired 90% of Southwest Antennas, Inc. (“SWA”) for cash paid at closing. The balance of the Company will continue to be owned by SWA’s CEO, Ben Culver. Further terms and financial details were not disclosed.
articles.title: HEICO CORPORATION ACQUIRES IMPORTANT HIGH-PERFORMANCE RF AND MICROWAVE ANTENNA COMPANY

articles.summary: MIAMI, FL — HEICO CORPORATION (NYSE: HEI.A) (NYSE: HEI) today announced that its Flight Support Group has acquired 80% of the stock of Sherwood Avionics and Accessories, Inc. (“Sherwood”). The balance of the Company’s ownership will continue to be held by members of Sherwood’s management team. Transaction terms and financial details were not disclosed.
articles.title: HEICO CORPORATION ACQUIRES MAJOR DEFENSE APU & COMPONENT OVERHAUL BUSINESS

articles.summary: 3D PLUS, Exxelia, and VPT Designed and Manufactured Components MIAMI, FL — HEICO Corporation (NYSE:HEI.A)(NYSE:HEI) commends NASA and its team for a successful Artemis II mission, and proudly reports that its subsidiaries 3D PLUS, Exxelia, and VPT supplied mission-critical electronic components on NASA’s Artemis II mission.
articles.title: THREE HEICO SUBSIDIARIES SUPPLY MISSION-CRITICAL PARTS FOR ARTEMIS II LAUNCH
